agentType.description: Role of the agent. MAIN is an alias of FOREMAN. Exactly one agent must be the foreman.

credentialStrategy.description: Whose code-forge credentials the runs use. It overrides the factory value.

description.description: Short description that list_agents shows to the foreman.

environmentId.description: ID of the environment of the runs. null clears the inherited value.

harness.description: Sparse override of the inherited harness. It changes only the fields that you set. Set auth to null to clear the inherited credential.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes that a finished run keeps its sandbox and session for follow-ups. 0 ends the session after each turn. Without a value, the server default OF_IDLE_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT applies (10 minutes) to every run. OF_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MAX (60 minutes) is the upper limit.

machine.description: Machine of the runs: the name of a file machines/<name>.yaml. It replaces the inherited machine.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers of the runs. They replace the mcpServers of agentDefaults. {} removes those defaults. The factory-wide servers always stay.

model.description: Model shorthand. A Claude model selects the claude harness. An OpenAI model selects the codex harness. Do not set it together with harness.

networkPolicy.description: Network policy of the agent. It merges with the policy of the factory.

secrets.description: Secret names of the runs. They replace the secrets of agentDefaults. [] removes those defaults. The factory-wide secrets always stay.

snapshot.description: If false, a snapshot stores only the harness state, not the workspace.

spawnableBy.description: Agents that can start this agent with run_agents. Without a value, only the foreman can. [] means no agent. Each name must be an agent of the definition.

workerHost.description: Worker that runs the agent. The value is trimmed. null or empty clears an inherited host. Where the agent sessions execute. server: the team's default sandbox provider. A sandbox provider ID (for example cloudflare-sandbox, daytona, boatdev): that provider. A worker ID or name: that enrolled worker. pool:<label>: the least-loaded online worker with that label.
